description: This PHP source file handles WiFi spectrum analysis via AJAX, including functions for MAC address translation, result rearrangement, and retrieving neighboring WiFi diagnostic results for use in a web UI.

methods.name: mac_translate
methods.description: Translates MAC address to a standardized uppercase colon-separated format.

methods.name: rearrange_SDTR
methods.description: Adds newline characters after the third comma-separated value in a string.

methods.name: get_results
methods.description: Fetches neighboring WiFi diagnostic results and processes BSSID format.
